issue.title: Guide beginners what mockito version to use
issue.body:
_I found github issues to be the right place for this, as the "solution" should be a simple description added to the readme._

To me it's unclear if I as a first-time user should download the [latest stable build](https://github.com/mockito/mockito/releases/tag/v1.10.19) or the [latest beta build](https://github.com/mockito/mockito/releases/tag/v2.0.52-beta). Yes, this is a general choice and I tend to always go for the latest stable build, but in this case 1.10.19 is over a year old!

I'm asking for whoever who knows something about mockito to add a short "guideline" in the readme helping beginners to pick a version that they won't regret a year from now (or whenever 2.0 is released, #123).

I hope this request is appreciated. I can't imagine I'm the first person feeling a bit lost by this. Cheers.
